info.title: PetStore Register
info.description: Categories, pets, and orders for the PetStore app.

x-openregister.description: PetStore — pets, orders, categories on the Conduction stack.

petstore.title: PetStore
petstore.description: Categories, pets, and orders for the PetStore app.

category.title: Category
category.description: A category of pets (Dogs, Cats, Reptiles, Fish, ...).

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the category, as shown in the pet catalogue and in the Category picker on a pet.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short prose describing what belongs in this category; shown under the name on the category detail page.
description.example: Friendly mammals, four legs, often barks

name.title: Name
name.description: The pet's name, as advertised in the store. This is the only field the portal `renamePet` action is allowed to write (REQ-PAV-003).

category.title: Category
category.description: Reference to the pet's category (uuid of the category object).

status.title: Status
status.description: Sale state of the pet: `available` (on offer), `pending` (reserved by an unfulfilled order) or `sold`. Back-office only — the portal create-action cannot set it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-text labels used to filter and group pets in the catalogue (e.g. `puppy`, `hypoallergenic`). Not a relation — see `category` for the typed one.

photoUrls.title: Photo URLs
photoUrls.description: Absolute URLs of the pet's photos, in display order; the first is used as the thumbnail in list and card views.

price.title: Price
price.description: Asking price of the pet in the store's currency, excluding tax. Back-office only — the portal create-action cannot set it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Internal free-text notes about the pet (temperament, medical history, handling instructions). Staff-facing.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Portal-subject/owner reference — the UUID of the owner contact (a domain object reference, never a Nextcloud user id). Portaliq scopes external portal reads to this field (hydra ADR-046 A4). The contact object is the portal subject that portaliq resolves and signs into the X-Portal-Subject `sub` claim; it belongs to portaliq's subject registry, not to the petstore register set, so OpenRegister cannot resolve a $ref for it (ADR-062 rule 7, external-reference form).

order.title: Order
order.description: A customer order for a pet — the base order/agreement primitive shared with other Conduction order-bearing apps (concrete kinds discriminate via orderType). PetStore populates it as a `sales` order per pet purchase.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Reference to the ordered pet (uuid of the pet object). This is the canonical order→pet relation (ADR-062 rule 7: relations are typed $ref+format:uuid fields, never free-text) — it replaces `projectReference` as a human-readable label for the exemplar's own KPI/relation teaching. Without it, 'Orders for this pet' cannot be computed.

orderType.title: Order Type
orderType.description: Discriminator selecting the order kind; PetStore orders are 'sales'.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: incoming (we receive) vs outgoing (we issue) — PetStore sales are outgoing.

orderDate.title: Order Date
orderDate.description: Calendar date the order was placed. Distinct from the object's own created timestamp, which records when the row was written.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code the monetary amounts on this order are expressed in.

basePrice.title: Base Price
basePrice.description: Net amount before tax, before any deposit is applied.

taxRate.title: Tax Rate
taxRate.description: Tax percentage applied to the base price (21 means 21%).

estimatedTotal.title: Estimated Total
estimatedTotal.description: Projected gross total (base price plus tax) before the order is finalised. `totalAmount` carries the agreed figure.

projectReference.title: Project Reference
projectReference.description: Optional free-text project label — superseded by the typed `pet` relation above for anything the app needs to query or KPI on.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this order for tenant isolation.

orderId.title: Order ID
orderId.description: Identifier this order carries in the upstream system it was imported from; empty for orders created here. Not the object's own id.

bookingTypeId.title: Booking Type ID
bookingTypeId.description: Booking-kind identifier carried by the shared order primitive; unused by PetStore, which only issues `sales` orders.

customerId.title: Customer ID
customerId.description: Identifier of the customer in the upstream system, from the shared order primitive. For portal scoping use `owner`; for the placing Nextcloud user use `customer`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what was ordered, shown on the order detail page and on any generated document.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of units of the referenced pet on this order line. One of the three fields the portal create-action may set.

shipDate.title: Ship Date
shipDate.description: Date and time the pet is expected to be handed over or shipped. One of the three fields the portal create-action may set.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state of the order: `placed`, `approved`, `delivered` or `cancelled`. `POST /api/orders/{id}/cancel` is the only route that moves it to `cancelled` (REQ-ORDER-CANCEL-001).

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: True once the order has been fully handled and needs no further action. Independent of `status`, which records where it got to.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Nextcloud UID of the user who placed the order (display-only, not an authorization boundary).

depositRequired.title: Deposit Required
depositRequired.description: True when the order may not proceed until a deposit is paid.

depositAmount.title: Deposit Amount
depositAmount.description: Amount of the required deposit, in the order's currency. Meaningful only when `depositRequired` is true.

depositPaymentId.title: Deposit Payment ID
depositPaymentId.description: Identifier of the payment that settled the deposit, in whichever payment system took it. Empty until the deposit is paid.

paymentTermsDays.title: Payment Terms Days
paymentTermsDays.description: Number of days after invoicing that payment is due — the numeric form of `paymentTerms`, for computing a due date.

invoiceId.title: Invoice ID
invoiceId.description: Identifier of the invoice raised for this order in the billing system. Empty until the order is invoiced.

completedAt.title: Completed At
completedAt.description: Date and time the order was completed. Set when `complete` becomes true.

state.title: State
state.description: Free-form workflow state carried by the shared order primitive, alongside the constrained `status` enum. PetStore does not drive it; `status` is this app's lifecycle field.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Portal-subject/owner reference — the UUID of the owner contact (a domain object reference, never a Nextcloud user id). Portaliq scopes external portal reads and creates to this field (hydra ADR-046 A4). The contact object is the portal subject that portaliq resolves and signs into the X-Portal-Subject `sub` claim; it belongs to portaliq's subject registry, not to the petstore register set, so OpenRegister cannot resolve a $ref for it (ADR-062 rule 7, external-reference form).
